summary: Completed e2e testing of new Agremo-style analytics features, DroneVideoStream, Robot3DViewer, and Language Selector. Backend APIs all working (12/14 pytest tests passed - 2 transient network issues). Frontend Analyse Avancée page fully functional with all 5 tabs working. Minor issue: Robot3DViewer has React Three Fiber runtime errors in development mode.

minor.issue: FIXED - Had date calculation bug (day out of range), fixed by using timedelta(days=7) instead of replace(day=day+7)
2 transient 502/connection errors during pytest run - likely network issues, not code bugs

ui_bugs.issue: React Three Fiber throws runtime errors in development mode due to build tooling adding x-line-number attributes that R3F cannot handle. The 3D canvas shows error overlay but rest of page works. This is a known R3F/React dev tools conflict.

issues: DialogContent missing DialogTitle for accessibility - console warnings about screen reader support

action_items: Robot3DViewer fix needed: Either disable React devtools source mapping for @react-three/fiber components or wrap Canvas in a more robust error boundary. Issue is x-line-number attributes being injected by build tooling that R3F cannot handle.
Add DialogTitle to modal dialogs for accessibility compliance
critical_code_review_comments: agremo_analysis_service.py: Fixed date bug on line 475 - was using replace(day=day+7) which fails at month boundaries
Robot3DViewer.jsx: Added error boundary class but R3F errors are thrown asynchronously so boundary doesn't catch them
All Agremo endpoints return properly structured JSON with simulated analysis data (MOCKED)
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/components/Robot3DViewer.jsx - Added error boundary (partial fix), removed problematic Line component
